proc.title: Augustana - Application procedure for international students

to.title: Augustana - Applying to Augustana test optional

test_policy.notes: Test optional since 2007. ACT/SAT scores are supplemental and are considered only if self-reported or sent; test-optional applicants are fully eligible for academic scholarships. Some students may be asked to complete an interview. The admissions policy page lists ACT/SAT, or TOEFL/IELTS for international students, among the scores reviewed.

requirements.notes: Augustana Application or Common App (reviewed the same). Application fee: not stated on the pages read and the CDS fee boxes did not extract, so left null. Writing sample required of all applicants (case-by-case exceptions); admissions interview required for Early Decision and highly recommended for others; teacher/school letter of recommendation recommended, not required; international applicants must submit a Certification of Finances. Unofficial transcripts can be uploaded to apply, official ones are needed to matriculate. International applicants may enter in fall (late August) or spring (late January).

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding), fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Requires an admissions interview and signed ED agreement; tuition deposit due Dec. 20. Page prints no year; taken as the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding), fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Deposit due May 1. Page prints no year; taken as the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Rolling decisions starting in early January; deposit due May 1. Page prints no year; taken as 2027.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision, spring 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Spring enrollment deadline Nov. 1; decision Nov. 15; tuition deposit due Dec. 1.

deadlines.label: Tuition deposit (Early Action and Regular Decision, fall)

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for applicants whose first language is not English. Exemptions: graduation from an accredited U.S. high school after at least three consecutive years, U.S. associate's degree, full IB Diploma in English, CEA-accredited intensive English program, secondary diploma/citizenship from a listed English-speaking country, IB English A grade 5+, AP English Language 4+, IGCSE English First Language C/4+, A-level English B+, or B+ in college composition courses. Test scores must be under 2 years old. Scores may be self-reported to get a decision; official scores are required at deposit. No conditional admission or ESL pathway was found on the international admissions pages (ELS Level 112 completion is accepted as proof).

english.notes: Exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026 (PBT 550). TOEFL Essentials 9.5 also accepted.
Exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026 (1-6 scale).
Minimum level C1 (no numeric score published).

aid.notes: Merit scholarships and need-based aid are both offered to international students. All applicants are automatically considered for merit awards; need-based aid requires the International Student Financial Aid application in the applicant portal. Published first-year academic merit awards for students first enrolling 2027-28: Presidential $33,000, Dean's $31,000, Founders $29,000 per year (renewable with GPA). Early Decision admits get a minimum $35,500 per year for campus residents with a full meal plan. Amounts for individual international students are set case by case. CDS H6: 506 nonresidents received institutional aid, average $39,902.
